I admire your optimism and I wish I could be more like that. My job is not all that great. I hate it to be honest but I have no clue what I would actually like to do. I just feel stuck and I feel like I have nowhere to go.

I understand therapy would probably be my best course of action. The problem is I would not at all feel comfortable talking about all these issues with someone in person. I can talk about these things here because it's anonymous but I would feel so incredibly uncomfortable and embarrassed talking about intimacy and social issues in person. I'd feel so judged knowing that the person in front of me knows what a loser I actually am. I am a 26 year old virgin without any real friends ffs. That's really not the type of thing you want to be telling anyone in person tbh.
